description: N400 ERP component from word-pair semantic judgment task. 40 neurotypical adults. Part of the ERP CORE project (Kappenman et al., 2021).
citation: Kappenman, E. S., Farrens, J. L., Zhang, W., Stewart, A. X., & Luck, S. J. (2021). ERP CORE: An open resource for human event-related potential research. NeuroImage, 225, 117465.
notes: EEGLAB .set/.fdt format. 33 channels (28 EEG + 2 HEOG + 1 VEOG + 2 reference). Recorded at 1024 Hz. Referenced to average of P9 and P10. Word-pair semantic judgment task: subjects judge whether word pairs are semantically related or unrelated. Event codes: first digit = stimulus list (1 or 2), second digit = related (1) or unrelated (2), third digit = variant (1 or 2). Codes 2xx are target words (epoch-lock), 1xx are prime words. Code 201 = correct response, 202 = incorrect. N400 expected over central-parietal sites (Cz, CPz, Pz) at 300-500 ms, more negative for unrelated than related words. Original data in subject subdirectories (e.g., original_data/1/1_N400.set).
